meta.title: Software, Web & AI Automation Services | Automation God
meta.description: Website design, custom software, workflow automation, AI chatbots, booking, CRM, reviews and SEO for Ontario businesses. All services free for 3 months.

hero.label: What We Do
hero.headline: Everything Your Business Needs, in One Place.
hero.subheadline: From websites and custom software to workflow automation and AI assistants, we handle the digital work so you can focus on running your business. All services free for your first 3 months, no strings attached.

services.title: Website Design & Build
services.tagline: A fast, modern website that works as hard as you do.
services.description: We design and build websites that look great on every device, load quickly and make it easy for customers to contact or buy from you.
services.outcome: A website you own, built around your business

services.title: Custom Software
services.tagline: Tools built around how your business actually works.
services.description: When off-the-shelf software doesn't fit, we build what does: internal tools, customer portals, dashboards and integrations between the systems you already use.
services.outcome: Software that fits your process, not the other way round

services.title: Workflow Automation
services.description: We map how work moves through your business and automate the repetitive steps: follow-ups, data entry, quotes, invoices, reports and handoffs between the apps you already use.
services.outcome: Less manual work and fewer mistakes

services.title: AI Assistants & Chatbots
services.tagline: Answer customers instantly, day or night.
services.description: We build AI assistants trained on your own business information. On your website they answer common questions, capture leads and book appointments. Inside your business they help your team find information and draft emails and documents.
useCases: Website chat assistant trained on your business
Answers about services, hours and pricing
Internal assistant for your team's documents
services.outcome: Customers get answers even when you're busy

services.title: Online Booking & Ordering
services.tagline: Let customers book, order and pay online, any time.
services.description: We set up booking, scheduling and ordering systems with payments and automatic reminders, so you spend less time on the phone and fewer appointments get missed.
services.outcome: Customers book and pay without a phone call

services.title: Customer Management & Follow-Up
services.tagline: Never lose track of a lead or a customer again.
services.description: We build a simple system to keep every lead and customer in one place, and automate the follow-up texts and emails that keep people coming back.

services.title: Automated Review Collection
services.tagline: Turn happy customers into 5-star reviews, automatically.
services.description: After each job or sale, your customers get a friendly, well-timed request to leave a review. We set it up once and it runs on its own.
useCases: Automatic review requests by text or email
services.outcome: A steady stream of reviews without chasing anyone

services.title: Website Care Plans
services.tagline: Hosting, updates and support for one simple monthly fee.
services.description: We keep your website fast, secure and up to date, so you never have to worry about hosting, backups or broken pages.
services.outcome: A website that stays online and up to date

services.title: Anything Else You Need
services.tagline: Have a different problem? Tell us.
services.description: If a technology problem is holding your business back, we'll tell you honestly whether we can solve it and how.
useCases: Not sure what you need? We'll help you figure it out
Reviewing your current tools and setup
services.outcome: A clear plan before any work begins

services.title: SEO
services.tagline: Get found by people searching for what you offer.
services.description: We improve your site and online presence so you show up when customers search, and make sure the basics like Google Business Profile, page speed and content are done properly.
services.outcome: More visibility where your customers are searching

pricing.label: Our Offer
pricing.headline: All Services Free for 3 Months.
pricing.subheadline: No strings attached. Every project is scoped to your needs, so book a call and we'll agree on exactly what's included. Refer another business and get an extra 6 months free on top of your first 3.

tiers.name: 3 Months Free
tiers.description: Use any or all of our services free for your first three months. If it's not for you, walk away.
features: Every service we offer is included
Clear quote if you decide to continue
Refer a business: get 6 extra months free

cta.headline: Not Sure Where to Start?
cta.subheadline: Book a free 30-minute discovery call. Tell us what your business needs and we'll recommend where to begin. No commitment required.
